title: cephaelis brachypus
intro: Cephaelis brachypus, commonly known as Wild Coffee, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae, native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis brachypus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit analgesic, antipyretic, and spasmolytic effects. The plant's bioactive constituents have been studied for their potential to provide relief from pain, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity.
